naturalized_text: Aku pancen ngujo carane angel wong kulit ireng

original_text: Luwih becik yen kita njeblug wilayah imigran
naturalized_text: Luwih becik yen kita njeblug wilayah pendatang

original_text: Masyarakat ora becik amarga wong-wong kaya kulawarga imigran sampeyan ora kena banget
naturalized_text: Wong-wong ora becik merga kaya wong pendatang kaya keluargamu sing ora kena banget.
